annotations.title: Facts and links for a post or ad

description: Everything needed to write social posts, ads or an email about one of your listings: title, description, price, image links, the page link with tracking for the channel, and audience notes. Also returns a guide for the chosen channel (image shapes and sizes, how a post is usually built, where the link goes), what the listing photos should cover, and what copy must never claim. Write the copy from these facts only; never promise delivery times or quality guarantees. Needs a connected Printlooper account.
name: get_marketing_kit
